description:
A Medium monstrosity built like a squat armored rhinoceros with rust-stained bone plates fused to its hide. It serves as a front-line bruiser for wilderness warbands: slow to think, terrifying to stand against. Target challenge rating 4.

Combat profile: walking speed 30 feet; natural armor around AC 15; hit points in the 60–75 range from a sturdy Constitution. Ability emphasis: Strength 18, Constitution 16, Dexterity 10, Intelligence 6, Wisdom 12, Charisma 8. No flight, no spellcasting, no legendary actions, no lair.

Offense: one primary melee weapon attack (a heavy flanged mace or similar) with reach 5 feet, solid attack bonus and bludgeoning damage appropriate for CR 4. Optional secondary trait such as Charge or Trampling Rush, but keep the stat block straightforward—single phase, one default armor class, no resource pools.
